preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of edges m must not exceed the maximum number of edges in a simple graph with n vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' if m > n * (n - 1) // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of edges exceeds the maximum possible, output 'Impossible'.
If a valid graph exists, output 'Possible' followed by m edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(edge.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(edge.split()[1]) <= n for edge in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range from 1 to n.
